sectionTwo.heading: LMI’s Petroleum Transportation
sectionTwo.description: Petroleum has been LMI’s core business for decades. This is what that looks like in practice.

cards.heading: Our tanker fleet
paragraphs: Tankers for crude oil and condensate, white oil products (HOBC, HSD, MS, gasoline, Jet A-1), furnace oil and LDO, and bitumen.
Every vehicle is inspected before dispatch, fitted with fire-safety equipment, and driven by trained, screened drivers. [Confirm: tanker capacities / types]

cards.heading: Oil majors and operators
paragraphs: Cartage contractor to Shell Pakistan (certified 2002), Pakistan State Oil (since 1983) and Caltex (since 1984). Crude and condensate transport for BP Pakistan E&P.
Also supporting refineries and energy companies such as Cnergyico. [Confirm: which clients can be named]

cards.heading: From Karachi, nationwide
paragraphs: Loaded from Karachi terminals and refineries to depots, plants and customers across Pakistan, with our 10-acre base facility in Karachi supporting operations.

items.question: Which petroleum products do you transport?
items.answer: Crude oil and condensate, HOBC, HSD, MS, gasoline, furnace oil, Jet A-1, LDO and bitumen.

items.question: Can you handle regular scheduled supply runs?
items.answer: Yes. We plan recurring lifting around your supply schedule, backed by an assured fleet ready exactly when required.

items.question: Do you move petroleum from Karachi to other cities?
items.answer: Yes. We transport petroleum products from Karachi to destinations across Pakistan.

items.question: How is safety managed?
items.answer: Through a strict HSE policy: trained drivers, pre-dispatch vehicle inspection, protective equipment and emergency response procedures, in line with ISO 9001 standards.
